name: FARLEY, David

headline.note: A long private-sector agribusiness career is documented, but sources do not establish substantive full-time status and exact non-overlapping boundaries for the entire sequence. Executive titles are not treated as proof of full-time work. Governance, advocacy, campaigning and elected office are excluded; missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.role: Jackaroo, later overseer, station manager and irrigation development specialist
career_spells.evidence_note: The current party biography supplies the employer and role progression; a March 2026 local interview gives a 1975 start and says he moved from jackaroo through overseer and irrigation-development work before the northern NSW appointment. Exact role-transition and cessation dates, employment entity, hours and leave are unresolved. First speech names Boonoke station and identifies Rupert Murdoch and Ken Cowley among owners. Age17 and long workdays are not converted to dates or full-time status.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but year-only boundaries and absent substantive full-time evidence do not establish an exact countable interval.

career_spells.role: Farm manager and operational leadership roles
career_spells.evidence_note: First-party and local reporting place his appointment to develop the northern NSW irrigation enterprise in 1982, while the public professional-profile search result says he joined Colly Cotton as farm manager in 1983. The profile says promotion to managing director/CEO occurred in 1990. The one-year start conflict, legal employing entity, exact dates, hours and leave are unresolved. First speech identifies Collymongle and1982 crop development, which is not necessarily his appointment year.2002 trade report says farm manager1983 and managing director1988; retain unresolved conflicts with existing1982 start/1990 promotion.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but conflicting year-level evidence and absent substantive full-time evidence preclude an exact total.

career_spells.role: Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer
career_spells.evidence_note: The public profile records promotion in 1990. The party biography describes more than two decades at the enterprise, while the local interview says 19 years; neither establishes a precise cessation date. The senior titles are not treated as proof of full-time work. WA government records MD of Colly Farms Cotton Ltd on28August1995.2002 trade report gives1988 MD promotion, conflicting with public profile1990. Exact Colly end precedes Visypak/Calcot but remains unknown; do not use rounded16-year narrative to calculate it.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but the end date and full-time status are insufficient for an exact headline calculation.

career_spells.evidence_note: Contemporary May2002 report announces appointment and planned official takeover1October2002, with familiarisation beforehand. USDA September/October2003 reports departure and successor after eight months; November/December issue says nine months and Norris interim since June. career_spells.counting_note: The cooperative executive role is private-sector employment, but its dates and substantive full-time status are not sufficiently established.

career_spells.role: Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer
career_spells.evidence_note: Company filings confirm appointment1December2009 and employment cessation31July2013, superseding earlier month-only start and30July news-announcement endpoint.2011 report describes an indefinite executive service agreement and group payroll subsidiaries A.A.Company Pty Ltd/Chef’s Partner Pty Ltd; individual payroll entity remains to verify.2014 report distinguishes notice/leave payments from active service. Salary and title do not establish hours or breaks.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment and month/day boundaries are supported, but substantive full-time status is not directly evidenced.

career_spells.role: Executive Chairman; agricultural commodity trader, investor and consultant
career_spells.evidence_note: Public profile gives Executive Chairman from April2020; company describes trading/investment/consulting, NSW hearing confirms role June2025 and March2026 interview continuing operation.2011 AACo report also calls him Matrix Principal/Executive Chairman, establishing earlier involvement. April2020 cannot be treated as first-ever Matrix work. Removed9May2026 election placeholder endpoint because it did not prove business cessation. Continuity, periods of operational work versus governance, hours and post-election activity remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: A private self-employed/business role is supported, but hours and the relationship between election and continuing business activity are unresolved.

career_spells.counting_note: Governance/investment is excluded absent evidence that it was substantive full-time employment.

research_notes: The frozen official record contains no occupation text, so this initial record relies on a current party biography, primary company/government material, a public professional profile and reported interviews.
The 1982/1983 Colly commencement conflict is preserved rather than silently resolved; relative duration is not converted into an invented cessation date.
Executive titles are not treated as proof of substantive full-time work, so no private headline total is calculated despite extensive documented private-sector experience.
Company, board and advocacy overlaps are kept separate; the election date is not assumed to terminate private business activity.

Systematic follow-up2026-10-01 resolved AACo exact start/end, bounded Calcot to2002–2003, added omitted Visypak management and eight historical operational/governance distinctions, identified Matrix involvement by2011 and removed unsupported election-as-cessation placeholder.

AACo audited service-agreement/remuneration disclosures demonstrate paid employment but do not state individual hours; company-wide FTE headcount is not personal full-time proof. Notice/leave payouts and later share vesting do not extend service. Historical board roles overlap executive work and cannot be added as extra years.

Colly farm-manager1982/1983 and MD1988/1990 conflicts remain. Calcot planned1October2002 takeover is prospective; contemporary USDA eight/nine-month descriptions differ. Retain year boundaries until actual payroll/appointment evidence resolves the distinctions.

Searched contemporary company annual reports2011/2014, Tandou2007 report, Calcot appointment/succession news, USDA cooperative magazines, government1995 announcement and2026 first speech. Some historical PDF/industry endpoints failed; alternate public publisher route recovered Calcot appointment. No access controls bypassed. Next leads: Colly/Visypak historical reports, Calcot employment records, Matrix historical filings/client biographies, government board annual reports and current interests declaration. No individual full-time evidence found.

Second follow-up2October2026 added omitted consulting activity, Namoi governance and short-course study from contemporary public professional biography. Consulting client is not necessarily payroll employer; no public-sector years attributed merely because a government or multilateral body commissioned work.

Targeted AACo full-time/service-agreement queries returned remuneration and notice provisions, not personal contractual hours. Advertisements concern Farley’s staff; proposed abattoir full-time positions are workforce plans, not his status. Banking David Farley in World Bank/PPIAF2010 material is not identity-matched to agricultural executive and is excluded. Cotton Australia2011–12 anniversary-report mirror appears to contain historical board dates, but multi-column alignment and original report remain to verify; no date adopted. Further priority: original personal terms, Colly/Visypak transitions and consulting contracts.

Did Matrix work continue after election, and what leave or cessation arrangements applied?
Were Waverley Mills and Speak Up 4 Water roles paid substantive employment or governance only?
What were AACo contractual hours, individual payroll entity and any unpaid leave/breaks during1December2009–31July2013?
When precisely did Visypak employment and earlier Matrix operational work occur, and how did they overlap Colly/Calcot/AACo?
Can original Colly records resolve1988 versus1990 managing-director promotion and1982 versus1983 farm-manager commencement?
